kyy-logs-code-review-skill-code-review.description: Use when code has been written, before committing, or when merging a PR; also when the user says "review my code", "check before commit", "take a look at this change", "PR review", or asks for a strict review/merge gate.

kyy-logs-code-review-skill-code-review-z.description: 写完代码、提交前或合并 PR 时使用；用户说“帮我 review”“提交前检查一下”“看看这次改动”“PR review”，或要求严格审查/合入门禁时也使用。
